endorsements.quote: Models must be continuously monitored and refined, and the LHS must incorporate mechanisms for governance and assurance so that algorithmic knowledge remains aligned with clinical needs, ethical expectations, and system priorities as both the AI and the environment evolve.
Embedding AI within an LHS enables continuous monitoring of subgroup performance and supports early identification of inequities.

unlisted_practices: Embed AI within a learning health system through an action-oriented, cyclical AI lifecycle (Define Problem, Design AI, Engineer AI, Assess AI, Pilot AI, Deploy/Monitor) in which monitoring outputs feed subsequent problem definition.
Apply continuous assurance dimensions (performance consistency, safety, fairness, transparency, security) across every AI lifecycle stage rather than as one-time predeployment checkpoints.
Engage communities in AI model design, deployment, and monitoring so that they reflect patient population values and needs.

screen.reason: This paper presents the HALO model, a conceptual framework and governance model for integrating and assuring AI systems within a Learning Health System.
